title: Valid-input guessing program
statement: A one-register nondeterministic register program with no oracle deciders and four instruction labels is defined as follows: at label $0$ it chooses label $1$ or $2$; at label $1$ it checks whether the input is a valid plain encoding, continuing to label $3$ if so and rejecting otherwise; labels $2$ and $3$ halt with answers false and true, respectively.
